paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Overall performance 0.90\% of all LLMs in the ABS-AOS pattern. The stratification is divided into three levels: Tier-1 (OP_{GM} [55, 61]), Tier-2 (OP_{GM} [41, 49]), and Tier-3 (OP_{GM} [25, 27]).

model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the overall performance percentages of various Large Language Models (LLMs) in the ABS-AOS pattern. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing individual models, though explicit text labels for these categories are omitted from the chart. The vertical axis is a linear value axis labeled "Overall Performance (%)" in bold text, with a range starting at 0 and extending slightly above 60, featuring numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, and 60) alongside horizontal grid lines. The chart displays twelve individual, distinctly colored vertical bars set against a background divided by light vertical grid lines. Each bar is explicitly annotated at its peak with its exact numerical value. Moving from left to right, the sequence of bars, their colors, and their respective values are: a grayish-teal bar at 61.09, a slate blue bar at 48.28, a steel blue bar at 24.64, a mauve bar at 60.72, a muted blue bar at 48.83, a light brown bar at 27.22, a light blue bar at 54.83, a lavender bar at 43.79, a light tan bar at 46.36, a light gray bar at 44.09, a pale beige bar at 40.87, and a pale pink bar at 43.54. The data is visually unsorted, showing no strict ascending or descending progression. The tallest bar in the chart is the first one on the left at 61.09, while the shortest is the third bar from the left at 24.64. The chart consists only of individual bars without any grouping or stacking arrangements, and visual emphasis is primarily provided by the precise data labels resting above each bar.
model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance percentages of various Large Language Models (LLMs) in the ABS-AOS pattern, stratified into three performance tiers as indicated in the caption. The horizontal axis represents the distinct model categories, although explicit textual labels for each individual category are omitted from the axis. The vertical axis displays the numerical values, labeled "Overall Performance (%)" in bold, rotated text, utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 60 with numeric tick labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines appearing at regular intervals of 20. The chart consists of twelve individual, unsorted vertical bars, each filled with a different muted color and explicitly annotated with its exact numerical value positioned directly above the bar. Reading from left to right, the sequence features a grayish-green bar representing the highest value in the chart at 61.09, followed by a purple-gray bar (48.28), a blue-gray bar representing the lowest value (24.64), a dusty pink bar (60.72), a light blue-gray bar (48.83), a light brown bar (27.22), a light blue bar (54.83), a pale lilac bar (43.79), a pale peach bar (46.36), a light gray bar (44.09), a pale beige bar (40.87), and finally a pale pinkish-white bar (43.54). The bars are neither grouped nor stacked, and light vertical grid lines separate the unlabelled column sections in the background. The data does not follow a specific ascending or descending sort order, and apart from the precise numeric data labels atop each column, there is no additional visual emphasis such as bolding or highlighting applied to the bars.
